faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Everything you need to know about Sedgo.
faq.q1: How many reference files can I upload?
faq.a1: Up to 12 files: 9 images, 3 videos (≤15s), and 3 audio clips (≤15s).
faq.a2: Sedgo supports video generation from 4 to 15 seconds, defaulting to 5 seconds.
faq.a3: No watermarks. You have full ownership of generated content.
faq.a4: Images: PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP. Videos: MP4, MOV, WEBM. Audio: MP3, WAV, AAC.
faq.a5: Points are consumed per second of generated video, with rates depending on the selected model and resolution. Points never expire.
faq.q6: How do I contact customer support?
faq.a6: Send an email to support@sedgo.ai. Responses typically within 24 hours on weekdays.
